attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt) as router for the shared private network with node2/node3 (10.100.70.0/24): gave node1 a fixed static IP (10.100.70.10), enabled its dnsmasq DHCP server (forced to override the platform's coexisting DHCP responder, with host reservations for node2/node3) so it actively serves both peers, and added an nftables/UCI firewall rule rejecting inbound TCP/23 from the LAN. Verified all three are functioning, rebooted node1 natively, confirmed a changed boot ID proving a real restart, and re-verified all settings (static IP, active DHCP service issuing real DHCPACKs to node2/node3, and the telnet-reject rule) were still in place and serving live traffic afterward.
